positive_evidence.observation: Literal adanta section: छद अपवारण इत्येके followed by छदयति. Visually rechecked; short stem is unambiguous.
छद अपवारणे । छदयति; immediately contrasts छद संवरणे (10.36,215) — छादयति. Visually rechecked; the book itself distinguishes the short and long entries.
Alternative छद अपवारणे is listed after छेद द्वैधीकरणे in the adanta section. This is lexical-location evidence, not a directly printed छदयति witness.
छद अपवारण इत्येके । छदयति; agrees with printed SK. Its source edition is not independently identified here.

adversarial_counterevidence.finding: A real electronic textual discrepancy at the exact locus, not dismissed as a different-entry example. The current raw page and its two-entry public history do not identify an underlying printed edition or explain a rule/alternative reading for the long stem. No printed same-literal-a long-stem witness was located during this bounded check. A transcription error is plausible but NOT proved. This prevents a claim of exhaustive cross-edition certainty.

false_positive_long_witness.finding: The छादयति passage explicitly describes छद अपवारणे as स्वरितेत् and discusses optional nic/yauja behavior. This identifies the other marker-bearing entry corresponding to10.0370, rather than literal-final-a10.0481. The derivative is not evidence for silently replacing the supplied full citation. The electronic inventory repeats verse113 even in its adanta note; that repetition is not independent proof of application to the adanta entry.

positive_evidence.source: Daivam/Purusakara verse68 (electronic verse marker has an apparent18 transcription)
positive_evidence.observation: प्रकाशे लजयेद्; commentary explicitly लज प्रकाशने । कथादिः. Direct short-stem finite optative witness.
लज प्रकाशने followed by लजि alternative, लञ्जयति and लञ्जापयति. No p-less initial-long लाजयति is given here.
Actually prints लजि प्रकाशने and लञ्जयति, with nasal. Visually checked: do not misquote this as a direct unnasalized लजयति witness.

adversarial_counterevidence.finding: Names alternative laji and forms लञ्जयेद् / लञ्जापयेद्, and separately Bhvadi laj/laj/laji for rebuke/roasting. These differ in nasal/p-bearing morphology, class or meaning. None licenses submitted p-less initial-long lAj- for literal laja प्रकाशने.

alternative_other_entry.finding: Long लाजयति can be licensed from the marker-bearing consonant-final root; it is not the supplied literal-final-a प्रकाशने entry.

common_rule_inference.ordinary_short_derivation: 3.1.25 supplies intrinsic Curadi nic. The literal terminal a deletes by6.4.48. Balamonorama on6.4.48 explicitly uses कथयति and1.1.57 to say that deletion is sthanivat and therefore does not license upadha-vrddhi. Applied to the independently identified adanta छद/लज, newly apparent C-a-C is not a basis for7.2.116 to produce CAd/lAj. Regular nic stem formation yields chaday-/lajay-; licensed tense/person endings do not independently change this internal a in the selected nine non-aorist tenses. This is a general-rule inference anchored by printed finite witnesses, not a printed attestation for all134 cells.
common_rule_inference.why_puk_not_rescue: The alternative kathadi puK tradition lengthens the final vowel and inserts p: kath-a -> kath-A-paya, and the directly printed laji alternative is lañj-A-paya. It does not license converting internal a to A while omitting p: CAd- / lAj-. No new aliases are adopted.
common_rule_inference.school_standard: A positively source-licensed ordinary alternative cannot be rejected merely because of a different grammatical school. The sr acceptance has positive root-and-tense-specific commentary evidence. Here the search found that level of evidence for short stems and for other nasal/p-containing or differently marked roots; it did not establish such an alternative for submitted p-less long stems. The Cada electronic discrepancy nevertheless remains a real provenance uncertainty.

conclusion: Retain the128 conditional literal-reading rejections; no independent positive license was found for these actual p-less long stems. Do not represent the Cada electronic discrepancy as a proved typo or claim exhaustive edition coverage. If an independently verified primary edition licenses long Cada at the exact adanta locus, reopen all67 inputs symmetrically and derive all licensed endings before any score update.
